tasks.label: 2. Run: Main Console Demo
tasks.command: javac -d bin src/*.java; java -cp bin Main

tasks.label: 3. Run: Benchmark Suite (Export CSV & JSON)
tasks.command: javac -d bin src/*.java; java -cp bin PerformanceAnalyzer

tasks.label: 4. Run: All Java Step Tests (1-7)
tasks.command: javac -d bin src/*.java tests/*.java; foreach ($t in 1..7) { Write-Host "`n=== Running Step $t Test ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan; java -cp bin "Step${t}Test" 2>$null; if (-not $?) { java -cp bin "Step${t}SmokeTest" } }
